correctness.rationale: All claims concern a finite specified labelled graph with 3^12=531441 exact states. The direct verifier tests F^9=F^6 for all codes, derives entrance-time and basin counts by explicit integer recurrence, and displays a sharp witness 3156. The separate indegree-peeling functional-graph implementation independently obtains the period and basin statistics. The independent successor-neighbor coloring enumerator counts 145200 recurrent period-three states. Verified two generators yield 120 spatial permutations; a vertex-stabilizer bound proves this is the full automorphism group, and exhaustive orbit action yields 473 geometric classes and one orbit of sixty extremal states. Programs and outputs are embedded and were replayed on their actual source paths; no finite sample extrapolates to an infinite conclusion.

They do not determine the 145200 recurrent labeled states, 48400 temporal orbits, 473 symmetry classes, sharp entrance time six, or basin populations; the new claim excludes already implied qualitative facts as standalone novelty.

value.rationale: A canonical five-regular Platonic graph has a natural complete deterministic excitable-media dynamical system. Its exact 48400 temporal oscillators, 473 geometric classes, all individual basins, and sharp six-step convergence are nontrivial dynamical invariants, not a single arbitrary slice. The sixty extremal inputs sharing one spatial symmetry orbit adds a structural geometric feature. General theory addresses the qualitative persistence criterion but does not provide these detailed exact populations and sharp finite-time behavior. The result does not assert a graph-family theorem or importance beyond its justified canonical graph scope.
